newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1150 lbs couple lds 71.00.

On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Friday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were firm to mostly $1.00 higher. Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1175-1350 lbs 115.00-116.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 107.00 few 106.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs ld 111.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 97.00.
Wk to Date - 8,800 Week Ago - 5,500 Year Ago - 10,600
